text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen behind us,
Narita Top Road and I decided to go
express our gratitude for reaching this milestone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Doctor!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to safely win the Arima Kinen
and close out this year.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks. You two are really conscientious,
coming all the way just to report in.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, well, what can I say...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It was too blurry, so I couldn't really see.
...My eyes have gotten worse with age lately.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. This is a small token of
celebration from me to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Here are meal vouchers.
Feel free to use them together, the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Meal vouchers! Thank you very much.
We did it, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Yeah. But using it with friends sounds nice too.
Yeah. But sharing it with your friends could be nice too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Friends?
With the Umamusume from my generation... you mean?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Maybe it's not so bad every now and then
to look back on the old days with the folks you shared your youth with.
—And so, a few days later, Narita Top Road went out for a meal together with T.M. Opera O and Admire Vega.
Where we headed was—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, local Chinese food!
Sounds fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The teacher gave me a voucher for this shop.
Since we're here, let's reminisce.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's not overly formal like some fancy restaurant,
which seems like a much better fit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Opera O-chan,
where is Doto-chan?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, you see... I did invite them, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm not going! I can't go!
Definitely not.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Just the three of you, please, go right aheaaad!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, I can guess why they didn't show up, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Then I shall catch up with Doto-chan another time."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's have as much fun as we can together today,
the three of us! Just like back in the Classic year!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, do you remember
that Satsuki Sho?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "If I couldn't run, the fans would be far too heartbroken! Thinking about that made me utterly restless."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Instead of worrying about the fans, how about worrying about yourself first?
...Besides, I was the one on edge waiting to take you on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right. Opera O-chan really
surprised me back then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Speaking of surprises, Ayabe-san's fighting spirit during the Japanese Derby was incredible too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And above all, what happened during the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Top Road-san back then was,
how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You looked cool.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I looked cool?! Me?!
Whoa, I can't believe Ayabe-san just said that to me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, I meant after me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Wrong, shut up.
Go eat some gyoza or something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still, every single race was so thrilling and fun.
And the Senior year races after that, too..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget.
It is my most precious memory of all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Those two dreamlike years, where we all competed against each other...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I hope this becomes an unforgettable memory for all of our fans as well."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Still, looking back on it now, in terms of actual ability, the three of us are..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It was pretty much neck and neck, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Right. It was, quite literally, a three-way battle of titans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Though I kinda feel like I wanted to win a bit more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's precisely because we were neck and neck that we can sit together like this, happily chatting about the past over Chinese food.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Come on,
let's keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Master! Bring me fried rice, crab fried rice, and takana fried rice.
Along with a soup spoon!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera-chan? Isn't that a bit too much fried rice?
You need a bit more nutritional balance...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll just eat the pickled mustard greens fried rice.

And so, the big three of the same generation
enjoyed a neighborhood Chinese feast,
reminiscing about old times.

text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, a stylish European restaurant!
Sounds fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The teacher gave me a voucher for this shop.
Since we're here, let's reminisce.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see... It's quiet and very pleasant.

"Still, every single race was so thrilling and fun.

text_block_list.text: "I hope this becomes an unforgettable memory for all of our fans as well."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Still, looking back on it now, the three of our track records are..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san seemed to have the upper hand, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Out of the three of us, you've won the most GⅠs, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well, come to think of it...
But that's all thanks to the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's because the two of you were there that I was able to do my best. More than winning or losing every now and then, I feel like that matters the most.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! Come on, let's go all out today!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fair shopkeeper over there!
Bring me all of your personal recommendations!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera-chan? Everything!?
I wonder if I have enough meal tickets...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine.
If it's not enough, Opera O will pay the rest."

And so, the big three of the same generation
enjoyed a European-style party,
reminiscing about old times.

Sounds fantastic.

That sounds like it's going to be quite extravagant.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Still, looking back on it now, our track records are..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: A total victory for Top Road-san, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. People often spoke of them in the same breath, but... in the end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
T-That was just a fluke!
I believe our true abilities are evenly matched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I think good things came
precisely because I won so many times."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Something good...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I think Sensei went all out on the celebration to match how hard I worked.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm able to enjoy myself together with the two of you in a place we wouldn't normally get to visit.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's true.
And a master's spirit in celebrating their disciple
is the finest feast of all, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta admit, I'm a little jealous of that part.
Right, Ayabe-san?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
Through Top Road-san—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I feel like we were guided by our predecessors too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, Ayabe-san...
If Sensei heard those words, he'd surely be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now, since we're here, let's enjoy ourselves
even more. The night view is gorgeous!

And so, the big three of the same generation
enjoyed a party aboard a ship,
reminiscing about old times.
